about: Scrim layout guide cases (docs/transfer/specs/layout-guides.md). Every expectation was produced by running Scrim's own code.

sources.geometry: packages/engine/src/layoutGuides.ts: trackLayout(guide, length), guideShape(guide, frame), guideSnapTargets(guides, frame), drawLayoutGuides (count of fillRect calls at zoom 1, DPR 1, clip = frame)
sources.validation: packages/core/src/guides.ts guidesIssues, and applyPatch(updateNode(id, { guides })) on a frame "Frame" (id f), a box "Box" (id b) and a text "Label" (id t)
sources.inspector: apps/studio/src/editor/guideEdits.ts: switchType, parseGuideNumber, parseGuideColor, shownGuideNumber, addGuidePatch, readGuides, guidesPatch, guideFieldPatch

conventions.frame: the frame's measured border box in world px { x, y, width, height }
conventions.perGuide: one entry per guide, in list order: track = trackLayout along the guide's axis (columns: width, rows: height) — start is relative to the frame's edge; bands / xs / ys = guideShape, in world px (xs are constant-x lines, ys constant-y lines)
conventions.snapTargets: guideSnapTargets: zero-width rects (x lines, full frame height) then zero-height rects (y lines, full frame width), each de-duplicated in first-seen order; only visible guides; only lines inside the frame (±1e-6)
conventions.drawnAtZoom1: how many rectangles drawLayoutGuides fills for this frame at zoom 1, DPR 1, camera at the origin, clip = frame
conventions.numbers: rounded to 6 decimals in this file
conventions.expect: validation: "accept" | { refuse: "<verbatim PatchError message>" }; stored = what the document holds afterwards when it differs from the input

gutter 0 rows, start aligned

stretch with no room left: no bands, no lines

fixed columns past the frame: bands run outside (drawn clipped), snap lines outside are dropped
end alignment wider than the frame: start goes negative
square grid: interior lines only (frame edges not repeated)
square grid on an offset frame
square grid whose size divides the frame exactly (no line on the far edge)
square grid bigger than the frame: nothing
8 px grid on a 64 × 24 frame
fractional frame and stretch columns
a hidden guide still has a shape, but no snap lines and is not drawn
zero opacity: snaps (visible) but is not drawn
several guides on one frame: snap lines are the de-duplicated union (columns, rows and a grid)
Paper defaults stacked (12 columns, 12 rows, a 50 px grid) on a mobile frame
